Component {
              Type          CScript
              Name          "Impl"
              Show          on
              Position      [300, 65]
              Direction     up
              Flipped       off
              LabelPosition south
              Parameter {
                Variable      "DialogGeometry"
                Value         "[554 53 1259 942]"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "NumInputs"
                Value         "[1 num_channels 1 num_channels num_channels]"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "NumOutputs"
                Value         "[((3+1)*num_channels) num_channels num_channels"
"]"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {

                Value         "0"

              }
              Parameter {

              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "NumZCSignals"
                Value         "0"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "DirectFeedthrough"
                Value         "0"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "Ts"
                Value         "[[-2, Tclk/2];[0 -1]]"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "TerminalBasedSampleTimes"
                Value         "1"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "Parameters"
                Value         "p0, ph0, s0, d0, updown, Tclk, state_reload_mas"
"k, period_reload_mask, require_exact_compare_match, duration_and_phase_pu, nu"
"m_channels, d_min,  master_sync_out_mask"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "LangStandard"
                Value         "2"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "GnuExtensions"
                Value         "2"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "RuntimeCheck"
                Value         "2"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "HighlightLevel"
                Value         "0"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "Declarations"
                Value         "#include <float.h>\n"
"#include <math.h>\n"
"#include <stdio.h>\n"
"#include <stdint.h>\n"
"#include <stdlib.h>\n"
"\n"
"#define MODEL_TIME_BASE SampleTimeOffset(0)\n"
"\n"
"#define IN_Period InputSignal(0,0)\n"
"#define IN_Durations(i) InputSignal(1,(i))\n"
"#define IN_Sync InputSignal(2,0)\n"
"#define IN_Phase(i) InputSignal(3,(i))\n"
"#define IN_ForceTransition(i) InputSignal(4,i)\n"
"\n"
"#define DS_SyncIn DiscState(0)\n"
"\n"
"#define PAR_Period0 ParamRealData(0, 0)\n"
"#define PAR_Phase0(i) ParamRealData(1, i)\n"
"#define PAR_State0(i) ParamRealData(2, i)\n"
"#define PAR_StateDuration0(i) ParamRealData(3, i)\n"
"#define PAR_CarrierType ParamRealData(4, 0)\n"
"#define PAR_Tclk ParamRealData(5, 0)\n"
"#define PAR_StateReloadMask ParamRealData(6, 0)\n"
"#define PAR_PeriodReloadMask ParamRealData(7, 0)\n"
"#define PAR_RequireExactCmpMatch ParamRealData(8, 0)\n"
"#define PAR_DurationAndPhaseInPerUnit ParamRealData(9, 0)\n"
"#define PAR_NumberOfChannels ParamRealData(10, 0)\n"
"#define PAR_MinimumDuration(i) ParamRealData(11, i)\n"
"#define PAR_MasterSyncOutMask ParamRealData(12,0)\n"
"\n"
"#define CARRIER_TYPE_SAWTOOTH 0\n"
"#define CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE 1\n"
"\n"
"#define FLAG_SYNC (1 << 0)\n"
"#define FLAG_ZERO_HIT (1 << 1)\n"
"#define FLAG_PERIOD_HIT (1 << 2)\n"
"#define FLAG_FORCE_TRANSITION (1 << 3)\n"
"\n"
"static int64_t TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"static int64_t CarrierTimeScaling;\n"
"\n"
"// Custom States (CS)\n"
"static double* CS_Flags = NULL;\n"
"static int* CS_CountingUp = NULL;\n"
"static int* CS_CurrentState = NULL;\n"
"static int* CS_LastTriggeredState = NULL;\n"
"static double* CS_BaseTimeInTbs = NULL;\n"
"static double* CS_LatchedStateDurations = NULL;\n"
"static int64_t* CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs = NULL;\n"
"static int* CS_ForceTransitionIn = NULL;\n"
"static double* CS_LastPeriodInTbs = NULL;\n"
"static double* CS_PeriodInTbs = NULL;\n"
"\n"
"static double* NextSampleHitVector = NULL;\n"
"\n"
"static int CS_LatchedStates[2];\n"
"\n"
"static int NumChannels;\n"
"static int NumStates = 2;\n"
"\n"
"#define CLEAR_ALL_FLAGS(i)\\\n\tdo{\\\n\t\tCS_Flags[i] = 0;\\\n\t} while(0)\\"
"\n\n"
"#define SET_FLAG(i, flag)\\\n\tdo{\\\n\t\tCS_Flags[i] = (double)((uint16_t)CS"
"_Flags[i] | (uint16_t)flag);\\\n\t} while(0)\\\n\n"
"\t\n"
"#define CLEAR_FLAG(i, flag)\\\n\tdo{\\\n\t\tCS_Flags[i] = (double)((uint16_t)"
"CS_Flags[i] & ~(uint16_t)flag);\\\n\t} while(0)\\\n\n"
"#define FLAG_IS_SET(i, flag) (((uint16_t)CS_Flags[i] & (uint16_t)flag) != 0)"
"\n"
"\n"
"#define ANY_FLAG_IS_SET(i) (CS_Flags[i] != 0) \n"
"\n"
"#define IS_END_OF_SEQUENCE(i) (FLAG_IS_SET(i, FLAG_ZERO_HIT) || (FLAG_IS_SET("
"i, FLAG_PERIOD_HIT) && (PAR_CarrierType == CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE)))\n"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "StartFcn"
                Value         "// Number of channels is equal to the number of"
" provided \"duration\" signals\n"
"NumChannels = (int)PAR_NumberOfChannels;\n"
"\n"
"if (NumParameters != 13)\n"
"{\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Number of parameters does not match.\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"if (ParamNumDims(0) != 2 || ParamDim(0, 0) != 1 || ParamDim(0, 1) != 1\n"
"    || PAR_Period0 <= 0.0)\n"
"{\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Error in parameter 'Initial Period [s]': positive number"
" expected.\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"if (ParamNumDims(0) != 2 || ParamDim(0, 0) != 1 || ParamDim(0, 1) != 1\n"
"    || PAR_Tclk <= 0.0)\n"
"{\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Error in parameter 'Counter clock resolution (Tclk) [s]'"
": positive number expected.\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"if (ParamNumDims(0) != 2 || ParamDim(0, 0) != 1 || ParamDim(0, 1) != 1)\n"
"{\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Error in parameter 'Number of PWM channels': positive nu"
"mber expected.\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"if (NumChannels != ParamDim(3, 1))\n"
"{\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Width of the initial duration vector does not match the "
"number of PWM signals.\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"if (NumChannels != ParamDim(1, 1))\n"
"{\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Width of the initial phase vector does not match the num"
"ber of PWM signals.\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"// We may change this to allow also zero phase signals\n"
"if (NumInputSignals(3) != NumInputSignals(1))\n"
"{\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Width of phase and duration input has to be consistent."
"\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"// Nubmer of states must be consistent with the number of states\n"
"if (NumStates != ParamDim(2, 1))\n"
"{\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Width of the initial state vector has to be consistent w"
"ith the number of states given at the input.\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"// Two states per channel\n"
"CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs = (int64_t*) malloc(NumChannels*NumStates"
"*sizeof(int64_t));\n"
"\n"
"CS_LatchedStateDurations = (double*) malloc(NumChannels*NumStates*sizeof(int6"
"4_t));\n"
"\n"
"// Each channel has its own flags\n"
"CS_Flags = (double*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(double));\n"
"\n"
"// Bookkeeping whether the counter counts up or down\n"
"CS_CountingUp = (int*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(int));\n"
"\n"
"// Bookkeeping of the current state of each channel\n"
"CS_CurrentState = (int*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(int));\n"
"\n"
"// Bookkeeping of the last triggered state of each channel\n"
"CS_LastTriggeredState = (int*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(int));\n"
"\n"
"// BaseTimeInTbs may be different for each channel\n"
"CS_BaseTimeInTbs = (double*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(double));\n"
"\n"
"// Each channel with have a ForceTransition input\n"
"CS_ForceTransitionIn = (int*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(int));\n"
"\n"
"NextSampleHitVector = (double*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(double));\n"
"\n"
"CS_LastPeriodInTbs = (double*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(double));\n"
"\n"
"CS_PeriodInTbs = (double*) malloc(NumChannels*sizeof(double));\n"
"\n"
"if (!CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs || !CS_LatchedStateDurations || !CS_"
"Flags || !CS_CountingUp || !CS_CurrentState || !CS_LastTriggeredState || !CS_"
"BaseTimeInTbs || !NextSampleHitVector)\n"
"{\n"
"\tSetErrorMessage(\"Cannot allocate memory.\");\n"
"\treturn;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"for (int i=0; i < NumChannels*NumStates;i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i] = 0;\n"
"\tCS_LatchedStateDurations[i] = 0.;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"for (int i=0; i < NumChannels;i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\tCLEAR_ALL_FLAGS(i);\n"
"\tCS_CountingUp[i] = 0;\n"
"\tNextSampleHitVector[i] = DBL_MAX;\n"
"\tCS_CurrentState[i] = 0;\n"
"\tCS_LastTriggeredState[i] = 0;\n"
"\tCS_ForceTransitionIn[i] = 0;\n"
"\t// Current time represented in Tbs.\n"
"\tCS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] = floor(CurrentTime/MODEL_TIME_BASE+0.5);\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"TimerClkPeriodInTbs = floor(PAR_Tclk/MODEL_TIME_BASE+0.5); // == 2.0 --> 2 Tb"
"s are one Clk\n"
"\n"
"// CarrierType is the same for all channels\n"
"if(PAR_CarrierType == CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE)\n"
"{\n"
"\tCarrierTimeScaling = 2; // two sequences per period\n"
"}\t\n"
"else\n"
"{\n"
"\tCarrierTimeScaling = 1;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"for (int i=0; i < NumChannels; i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\t// Period is identical for all channels\n"
"\tCS_PeriodInTbs[i] = floor(PAR_Period0/CarrierTimeScaling/PAR_Tclk+0.5) * Ti"
"merClkPeriodInTbs; // Based on initial Period value.\n"
"\tif((CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/2) <= 0)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tSetErrorMessage(\"Period too small.\");\n"
"\t\treturn;\n"
"\t}\n"
"\tCS_LastPeriodInTbs[i] = CS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"// determine phase (-0.5 <= ph < 0.5 range)\n"
"int64_t MasterPhaseInTbs = 0;\n"
"for (int i = 0; i < NumChannels; i++) \n"
"{\n"
"\tint64_t phaseInTbs = 0;\n"
"\tint64_t phaseInClk = 0;\n"
"\tif(PAR_DurationAndPhaseInPerUnit\t== 1)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tphaseInClk = floor(PAR_Phase0(i)*CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/TimerClkPeriodInTbs+0."
"5);\n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tphaseInClk = floor(PAR_Phase0(i)/CarrierTimeScaling/PAR_Tclk+0.5);\n"
"\t}\n"
"\t// Check if master channel or not\n"
"\tif (i == 0)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tphaseInTbs = phaseInClk * TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\tMasterPhaseInTbs = phaseInTbs;\n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// Shift slave channels in respect of master channel --> add phase shift "
"of master of all slaves. \n"
"\t\tphaseInTbs = phaseInClk * TimerClkPeriodInTbs + MasterPhaseInTbs;\n"
"\t}\n"
"\t// Wrap phase to be in -0.5 ... 0.5 range\n"
"\twhile(phaseInTbs >= (CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/2))\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tphaseInTbs -= \tCS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"\t}\n"
"\twhile(phaseInTbs < -(CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/2))\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tphaseInTbs += \tCS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"\t}\n"
"\t// consider saw-tooth or triangle-mode\n"
"\tif(PAR_CarrierType == CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tif(phaseInTbs >= 0)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tCS_CountingUp[i] = 1;\n"
"\t\t\tphaseInTbs = 2*phaseInTbs;\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tCS_CountingUp[i] = 0;\n"
"\t\t\tphaseInTbs = CS_PeriodInTbs[i]+2*phaseInTbs;\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tif(phaseInTbs < 0)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tphaseInTbs = CS_PeriodInTbs[i]+phaseInTbs;\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\tCS_CountingUp[i] = 1;\t\n"
"\t}\n"
"\t// adjust sequence base-time to shift all transition times according to giv"
"en initial phase-shift\n"
"\tCS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] -= phaseInTbs;\t\n"
"\t// set flags\n"
"\tCLEAR_ALL_FLAGS(i);\n"
"\tif(PAR_CarrierType == CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// triangle mode\n"
"\t\tif(phaseInTbs == 0)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tif(CS_CountingUp[i] == 0)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_PERIOD_HIT);\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_ZERO_HIT);\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// sawtooth mode\n"
"\t\tif(phaseInTbs == 0)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_ZERO_HIT);\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse if(phaseInTbs == (CS_PeriodInTbs[i] - TimerClkPeriodInTbs))\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_PERIOD_HIT);\t\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"}\n"
"// latch new state vector\n"
"for (int i=0; i < NumStates; i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\tCS_LatchedStates[i] = PAR_State0(i);\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"for (int i=0; i < NumChannels;i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\t// prepare and latch absolute transition times\n"
"\tint64_t durationBaseTbs = 0;\n"
"\t\n"
"\tCS_LatchedStateDurations[i*NumStates] = PAR_StateDuration0(i);\n"
"\tint64_t durationInClk;\n"
"\tif(PAR_DurationAndPhaseInPerUnit\t== 1)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tdurationInClk = floor(PAR_StateDuration0(i)*CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/TimerClkPer"
"iodInTbs+0.5);\n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tdurationInClk = floor(PAR_StateDuration0(i)/CarrierTimeScaling/PAR_Tclk+0"
".5);\n"
"\t}\n"
"\tint64_t duration = durationInClk * TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\tif(CS_CountingUp[i] == 1)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// counting up\n"
"\t\t// add-up all duration times\n"
"\t\tif((durationBaseTbs + duration) < CS_PeriodInTbs[i])\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] "
"+ durationBaseTbs + duration;\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// clamp excessive durations\n"
"\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] "
"+ CS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// counting down\n"
"\t\t// for counting down mode add duration times in reversed fashion\n"
"\t\tif(durationBaseTbs + duration < CS_PeriodInTbs[i])\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[(i+1)*(NumStates)-2] = CS_BaseTimeI"
"nTbs[i] + CS_PeriodInTbs[i] - duration - durationBaseTbs;\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// clamp excessive durations\n"
"\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[(i+1)*(NumStates)-2] = CS_BaseTimeI"
"nTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"\t// close out with period time\n"
"\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[(i+1)*(NumStates)-1] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs"
"[i] + CS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"NextSampleHit = CurrentTime;"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "OutputFcn"
                Value         "if(IsMajorStep == 0)\n"
"{\n"
"\t// no change at minor step\n"
"\treturn;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"if(!IsSampleHit(0))\n"
"{\n"
"\t// counter change can only occur at sample hit 0\n"
"\t// but use this opportunity to reset output of event flags of master channe"
"l\n"
"\tfor(int i=0;i<(NumChannels*(3+1)); i++)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tOutputSignal(0,i) = 0;\n"
"\t}\n"
"\treturn;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"int64_t currentTimeInTbs = (int64_t)(floor(CurrentTime/MODEL_TIME_BASE+0.5));"
"\n"
"\n"
"for (int i=0;i<NumChannels;i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\t// update SZP flag outputs for all channels\n"
"\tOutputSignal(0,i*3+0) = FLAG_IS_SET(i,FLAG_SYNC);\n"
"\tOutputSignal(0,i*3+1) = FLAG_IS_SET(i,FLAG_ZERO_HIT);\n"
"\tOutputSignal(0,i*3+2) = FLAG_IS_SET(i,FLAG_PERIOD_HIT);\n"
"\t// generate \"capture\" events\n"
"\tif(CS_CountingUp[i] == 1)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tOutputSignal(0,NumChannels*3+i) = (currentTimeInTbs == CS_AppliedStateTra"
"nsitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates]);\n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tOutputSignal(0,NumChannels*3+i) = (currentTimeInTbs == CS_AppliedStateTra"
"nsitionTimesInTbs[(i+1)*NumStates-2]);\n"
"\t}\n"
"\t// output counter direction for all channels\n"
"\tOutputSignal(2,i) = CS_CountingUp[i];\n"
"\t\n"
"\t// update active state value output\n"
"\tint outIndex;\n"
"\tif (PAR_RequireExactCmpMatch == 1)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// only update at exact match (according to TI's ePWM behavior)\n"
"\t\tif(IS_END_OF_SEQUENCE(i))\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tCS_LastTriggeredState[i] = 0;\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\n"
"\t\tif(CS_CountingUp[i] == 1)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tif(currentTimeInTbs == CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates]"
")\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_LastTriggeredState[i] = 1;\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\t\n"
"\t\t\tif(currentTimeInTbs == CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[(i+1)*(NumSt"
"ates)-2])\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_LastTriggeredState[i] = NumStates-1;\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\toutIndex = CS_LastTriggeredState[i]; \n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// search for most recent transition\n"
"\t\toutIndex = 0;\n"
"\t\tdo \n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tif(CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates+outIndex] >= (curren"
"tTimeInTbs + TimerClkPeriodInTbs))\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tbreak;\n"
"\t\t\t}\t\t\n"
"\t\t   outIndex++;\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\twhile(outIndex < NumStates);\n"
"\t\t\n"
"\t\tif(outIndex == NumStates)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tSetErrorMessage(\"Output call: No valid output transition found!\");\n"
"\t\t\treturn;\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"\tif(CS_CountingUp[i] == 1)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tOutputSignal(1,i) = CS_LatchedStates[outIndex];\n"
"\t}\n"
"\telse\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tOutputSignal(1,i) = CS_LatchedStates[(NumStates-1)-outIndex];\t\n"
"\t}\n"
"}\n"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "UpdateFcn"
                Value         "int64_t currentTimeInTbs = (int64_t)(floor(Curr"
"entTime/MODEL_TIME_BASE+0.5));\n"
"\n"
"if(IsSampleHit(0))\n"
"{\n"
"\tfor (int i=0; i < NumChannels; i++)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tCLEAR_ALL_FLAGS(i);\n"
"\t}\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"// handle regular (scheduled) transitions\n"
"if(IsSampleHit(0))\n"
"{\n"
"\t// printf(\"IsSampleHit at: %lld \\n\", currentTimeInTbs);\n"
"\tfor (int i=0;i<NumChannels;i++)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tint64_t nextSampleHitInTbs = 0;\n"
"\t\tint index = CS_CurrentState[i];\n"
"\t\t// find next state to activate\n"
"\t\tdo {\n"
"\t\t\tnextSampleHitInTbs = CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates+in"
"dex];\n"
"\t\t\tif(nextSampleHitInTbs > currentTimeInTbs)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tif(index == (NumStates-1))\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\t\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t// we have reached the period entry\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tbreak;\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tint64_t pulseWidthInTbs = CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*Num"
"States+index+1] - nextSampleHitInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tif(pulseWidthInTbs >= TimerClkPeriodInTbs)  // Offset is half of th"
"e clk resolution --> a state must be at least two counter clocks long!\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t{\n"

"\t\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"

"\t\tCS_CurrentState[i] = index;\n"

"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// unable to find fitting step time\n"

"\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\n"
"\t\tif(nextSampleHitInTbs <= currentTimeInTbs)\n"

"\t\t\t\t{\n"

"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t} \n"

"\t\t\t\t// compare event\t\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"

"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t// compare event\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"

"\t\t\t\tif(FLAG_IS_SET(0, FLAG_ZERO_HIT) && (((uint16_t)PAR_PeriodReloadMask "

") * TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"

"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"\t//Find closest NextSampleHit\n"

"\tfor (int i=0; i < NumChannels; i++)\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t//  \n"

"}\n"
"\n"
"// check for new (asynchronous) synchronization edge on master channel --> sy"

"\t\t// determine phase (-0.5 <= ph < 0.5 range) of master channel\n"

"\t\tif(PAR_DurationAndPhaseInPerUnit\t== 1)\n"
"\t\t{\n"

"5);\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tphaseInClk = floor(IN_Phase(0)/CarrierTimeScaling/PAR_Tclk+0.5);\n"
"\t\t}\t\t\n"
"\n"
"\t\tint64_t phaseInTbs = phaseInClk * TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"

"\t\twhile(phaseInTbs >= (CS_PeriodInTbs[0]/2))\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tphaseInTbs -= \tCS_PeriodInTbs[0];\n"
"\t\t}\n"

"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tphaseInTbs += \tCS_PeriodInTbs[0];\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\t// consider saw-tooth or triangle-mode\n"
"\t\tif(PAR_CarrierType == CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tif(phaseInTbs >= 0)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_CountingUp[0] = 1;\n"

"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_CountingUp[0] = 0;\n"
"\t\t\t\tphaseInTbs = CS_PeriodInTbs[0]+2*phaseInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tif(phaseInTbs < 0)\n"

"\t\t\t\tphaseInTbs = CS_PeriodInTbs[0]+phaseInTbs;\n"

"\t\t}\n"
"\t\n"
"\t\t// establish new sequence base-time\n"

"meInTbs[0];\n"

"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse if(CS_BaseTimeInTbs[0] == nextSampleHitInTbs)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tCS_BaseTimeInTbs[0] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[0] - CS_PeriodInTbs[0];\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\t// update flags\n"
"\t\tif(PAR_CarrierType == CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// triangle mode\n"
"\t\t\tif(phaseInTbs == 0)\n"
"\t\t\t{\t\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t\tif(CS_CountingUp[0] == 0)\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t// when counting down, a phase 0 resets puts us right back to period"
"\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(0, FLAG_PERIOD_HIT);\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t// when counting up, a phase 0 resets puts us right back to zero\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(0, FLAG_ZERO_HIT);\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// sawtooth mode\n"

"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\tif(IS_END_OF_SEQUENCE(0))\n"
"\t\t{\t\n"
"\t\t\t// latch new period\n"
"\t\t\tCS_LastPeriodInTbs[0] = CS_PeriodInTbs[0];\t\n"
"\t\t\tCS_BaseTimeInTbs[0] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[0] + CS_LastPeriodInTbs[0];\t\n"
"\t\t\tif(FLAG_IS_SET(0, FLAG_ZERO_HIT) && (((uint16_t)PAR_PeriodReloadMask & "
"(uint16_t)FLAG_ZERO_HIT) != 0))\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_PeriodInTbs[0] = floor(IN_Period/CarrierTimeScaling/PAR_Tclk+0.5) "
"* TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t\tif((CS_PeriodInTbs[0]/2) <= 0)\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\t\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tSetErrorMessage(\"Period too small.\");\n"
"\t\t\t\t\treturn;\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t}\t\t\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"\n"
"// Only update slaves if there are actually slave channels\n"
"if (NumChannels > 1) \n"
"{\n"
"\t// Master channel CTR = 0 event --> load phase of all slaves!\n"
"\tif((FLAG_IS_SET(0, FLAG_ZERO_HIT) && (((uint16_t)PAR_MasterSyncOutMask & (u"
"int16_t)FLAG_ZERO_HIT) != 0)) || \n"
"\t\t(FLAG_IS_SET(0, FLAG_SYNC) && (((uint16_t)PAR_MasterSyncOutMask & (uint16"
"_t)FLAG_SYNC) != 0))) \n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// determine phase (-0.5 <= ph < 0.5 range)\t\n"
"\t\t// only loop over slave channels\n"
"\t\tdouble NextSampleHitVector[NumChannels];\n"
"\t\tfor (int i=1; i < NumChannels; i++) \n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tif(IS_END_OF_SEQUENCE(i))\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t// sync occurred just before a period event was scheduled\n"
"\t\t\t\t// need to revert changes caused by scheduled period\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] - CS_LastPeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t// flags will be reassessed below\n"
"\t\t\tCLEAR_FLAG(i, FLAG_ZERO_HIT); \n"
"\t\t\tCLEAR_FLAG(i, FLAG_PERIOD_HIT);\t\n"
"\t\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t// schedule sync event to next clock hit\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t currentTimeInClks = (currentTimeInTbs - CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i]) / "
"TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t nextSampleHitInTbs = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] + (currentTimeInClks +"
" 1)*TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\n"
"\t\t\t// we have a new sample hit\n"
"\t\t\tNextSampleHitVector[i] = (double)nextSampleHitInTbs * MODEL_TIME_BASE;"
"\n"
"\t\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t// Update slave period at counter zero event of master\n"
"\t\t\tCS_PeriodInTbs[i] = CS_PeriodInTbs[0];\t\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t// determine phase (-0.5 <= ph < 0.5 range)\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t phaseInClk = 0;\n"
"\t\t\tif(PAR_DurationAndPhaseInPerUnit\t== 1)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tphaseInClk = floor(IN_Phase(i)*CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/TimerClkPeriodInTbs+"
"0.5);\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tphaseInClk = floor(IN_Phase(i)/CarrierTimeScaling/PAR_Tclk+0.5);\n"
"\t\t\t}\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t// Shift slave channels in respect of master channel\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t phaseInTbs = phaseInClk * TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t// Wrap phase to be in -0.5 ... 0.5 range\n"
"\t\t\twhile(phaseInTbs >= (CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/2))\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tphaseInTbs -= \tCS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\twhile(phaseInTbs < -(CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/2))\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tphaseInTbs += \tCS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t// consider saw-tooth or triangle-mode\n"
"\t\t\tif(PAR_CarrierType == CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tif(phaseInTbs >= 0)\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tCS_CountingUp[i] = 1;\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tphaseInTbs = 2*phaseInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tCS_CountingUp[i] = 0;\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tphaseInTbs = CS_PeriodInTbs[i]+2*phaseInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tif(phaseInTbs < 0)\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tphaseInTbs = CS_PeriodInTbs[i]+phaseInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_CountingUp[i] = 1;\t\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t timeInPeriodAtNextSampleHitInTbs = nextSampleHitInTbs - CS_Base"
"TimeInTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t adjustmentInTb = (phaseInTbs - timeInPeriodAtNextSampleHitInTbs"
");\n"
"\t\t\tCS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] - adjustmentInTb;\n"
"\t\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t// make sure base-time is moved to past\n"
"\t\t\tif(CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] > nextSampleHitInTbs)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tSetErrorMessage(\"CS_BaseTimeInTbs was set to future.\");\n"

"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse if(CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] == nextSampleHitInTbs)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] - CS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t// update flags\n"
"\t\t\tif(PAR_CarrierType == CARRIER_TYPE_TRIANGLE)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t// triangle mode\n"
"\t\t\t\tif(phaseInTbs == 0)\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\t\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tif(CS_CountingUp[i] == 0)\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t// when counting down, a phase 0 resets puts us right back to perio"
"d\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_PERIOD_HIT);\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t// when counting up, a phase 0 resets puts us right back to zero\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_ZERO_HIT);\n"
"\t\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t// sawtooth mode\n"
"\t\t\t\tif(phaseInTbs == 0)\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_ZERO_HIT);\n"
"\t\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\t\telse if(phaseInTbs == (CS_PeriodInTbs[i] - TimerClkPeriodInTbs))\n"
"\t\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_PERIOD_HIT);\t\n"

"\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\tdouble nextHit = DBL_MAX;\n"
"\t\tfor (int i=1; i < NumChannels; i++)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tif (NextSampleHitVector[i] <= nextHit)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tNextSampleHit = NextSampleHitVector[i];\n"
"\t\t\t\tnextHit = NextSampleHitVector[i];\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"\n"
"// check for new (asynchronous) force_transition edge\n"
"for (int i=0; i < NumChannels; i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\tif(!FLAG_IS_SET(i, FLAG_FORCE_TRANSITION))\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\t// detect egde on synchronization signal\n"
"\t\tif((CS_ForceTransitionIn[i] == 0) && IN_ForceTransition(i))\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// check if pulse was captured during leading edge blanking time\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t durationInClk;\n"
"\t\t\tif(PAR_DurationAndPhaseInPerUnit\t== 1)\n"
"\t\t\t{\t\t\t\t\t\t\n"
"\t\t\t\tdurationInClk = floor(PAR_MinimumDuration(i)*CS_PeriodInTbs[i]/TimerC"
"lkPeriodInTbs+0.5);\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tdurationInClk = floor(PAR_MinimumDuration(i)/CarrierTimeScaling/PAR_T"
"clk+0.5);\n"
"\t\t\t}\t\t\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t duration = durationInClk * TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t// Set force transition flag only if pulse was detected outside the lea"
"ding edge blanking time\n"
"\t\t\tif ((double)currentTimeInTbs > (CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] + duration)) \n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tSET_FLAG(i, FLAG_FORCE_TRANSITION);\t\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\tCS_ForceTransitionIn[i] = IN_ForceTransition(i);\n"
"\t\n"
"\t\tif(FLAG_IS_SET(i, FLAG_FORCE_TRANSITION))\n"
"\t   {\n"
"\t   \t// schedule sync event to next clock hit\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t currentTimeInClks = (currentTimeInTbs - CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i]) / "
"TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t nextSampleHitInTbs = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] + (currentTimeInClks +"
" 1) * TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"         // we have a new sample hit\n"
"\t\t\tNextSampleHit = (double)nextSampleHitInTbs * MODEL_TIME_BASE;\n"
"\t   }\n"
"\t}\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"for (int i=0; i<NumChannels; i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\tif(ANY_FLAG_IS_SET(i) || ANY_FLAG_IS_SET(0))\n"
"\t{\n"
"\t\tif((FLAG_IS_SET(i, FLAG_ZERO_HIT) && (((uint16_t)PAR_StateReloadMask & (u"
"int16_t)FLAG_ZERO_HIT) != 0)) ||\n"
"\t\t\t(FLAG_IS_SET(i, FLAG_PERIOD_HIT) && (((uint16_t)PAR_StateReloadMask & ("
"uint16_t)FLAG_PERIOD_HIT) != 0)) ||\n"
"\t\t\t(FLAG_IS_SET(i, FLAG_SYNC) && (((uint16_t)PAR_StateReloadMask & (uint16"
"_t)FLAG_SYNC) != 0)))\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// latch new durations\n"
"\t\t\tCS_LatchedStateDurations[i*NumStates] = IN_Durations(i);\t\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\t// prepare and latch absolute transition times\n"
"\t\tint64_t durationBaseTbs = 0;\n"
"\t\tint64_t durationInClk;\n"
"\t\tif(PAR_DurationAndPhaseInPerUnit\t== 1)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tdurationInClk = floor(CS_LatchedStateDurations[i*NumStates]*CS_PeriodIn"
"Tbs[i]/TimerClkPeriodInTbs+0.5);\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\tdurationInClk = floor(CS_LatchedStateDurations[i*NumStates]/CarrierTime"
"Scaling/PAR_Tclk+0.5);\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\tint64_t duration = durationInClk * TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\tif(CS_CountingUp[i] == 1)\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// counting up\n"
"\t\t\tif(durationBaseTbs + duration < CS_PeriodInTbs[i])\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i"
"] + durationBaseTbs + duration;\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t// clamp error due to rounding of durationInClk\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates] = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i"
"] + CS_PeriodInTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\telse\n"
"\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t// counting down\n"
"\t\t\tif(durationBaseTbs + duration < CS_PeriodInTbs[i])\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[(i+1)*(NumStates)-2] = CS_BaseTim"
"eInTbs[i] + CS_PeriodInTbs[i] - duration - durationBaseTbs;\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t\telse\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\t// clamp error due to rounding of durationInClk \n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[(i+1)*(NumStates)-2] = CS_BaseTim"
"eInTbs[i];\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t\t// close out with period time\n"
"\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[(i+1)*(NumStates)-1] = CS_BaseTimeInT"
"bs[i] + CS_PeriodInTbs[i];\t\n"
"\t\tCS_CurrentState[i] = 0;\n"
"\t\t\n"
"\t\tif(FLAG_IS_SET(i, FLAG_FORCE_TRANSITION))\n"
"\t   {\n"
"\t\t\t// move next transition to now + 1 TBS\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t currentTimeInClks = (currentTimeInTbs - CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i]) / "
"TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\tint64_t nextSampleHitInTbs = CS_BaseTimeInTbs[i] + (currentTimeInClks +"
"1)*TimerClkPeriodInTbs;\n"
"\t\t\tif(CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates] > nextSampleHitInTb"
"s)\n"
"\t\t\t{\n"
"\t\t\t\tCS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i*NumStates] = nextSampleHitInTbs"
";\n"
"\t\t\t\tbreak;\n"
"\t\t\t}\n"
"\t\t}\n"
"\t}\n"
"}"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "DerivativeFcn"

                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "TerminateFcn"
                Value         "if (CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs)\n"
"{\n"
"   free(CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs);\n"
"}\n"
"if (CS_LatchedStateDurations)\n"
"{\n"

"}\n"
"if (CS_Flags)\n"

"}\n"

"if (CS_LastPeriodInTbs)\n"

"}"
                Show          off
              }
              Parameter {
                Variable      "StoreCustomStateFcn"
                Value         "for (int i=0; i < NumChannels*NumStates;i++)\n"
"{\n"
"\tWriteCustomStateDouble(CS_AppliedStateTransitionTimesInTbs[i]);\n"

"}\n"
"\n"

"{\n"

"\tWriteCustomStateDouble(CS_PeriodInTbs[i]);\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"\n"

                Show          off

"}\n"
"\n"
"\n"
"for (int i=0; i < NumChannels;i++)\n"
"{\n"

"}\n"
